profile.name: ASCII STL 文件写出器
profile.description: 用于将由三角形或四边形面片组成的三维几何体导出为 ASCII STL 文件的软件工具，常用于数控加工、3D 建模或实验装置零件的几何数据保存与交换。
profile.description_en: A software tool for exporting 3D geometry composed of triangular or quadrilateral faces to ASCII STL files, commonly used to save and exchange geometry for CNC machining, 3D modeling, or laboratory fixture parts.
